claims.evidence: Photo 1 shows partial tank text 'Kawasa...' confirming brand Kawasaki, but no model badge or fairing visible to confirm 'ZZR' designation.
No video or photo shows engine running, idling, or any dynamic test.
No receipt, registration date, or odometer reading visible; gauge cluster in photo 0 is unclear.
Static photos show brake lever and rear disc rotor only; no footage of shifting or braking in motion.
Only partial close-ups shown (cockpit, tank/seat, rear wheel); full frame, underside, and chain not visible.
No frame/engine number, no comparison to factory spec, no documentation shown.

risks.risk: Engine may not start or run properly
risks.proof: Video clip of cold start and idle, plus revving sound
risks.if_unproven: priced as non-running / needs mechanical inspection

risks.risk: True mileage unknown or odometer tampered
risks.proof: Clear, legible photo of odometer reading

risks.risk: Ownership/title not verified, possible stolen vehicle
risks.proof: Photo of registration papers, proof of ownership matching seller's name
risks.if_unproven: priced at steep discount for unverifiable title risk

risks.proof: Close-up photo of stamped frame/engine number
risks.if_unproven: priced as unverifiable identity, higher risk

risks.risk: Front wheel, tire, and front brake condition unknown
risks.proof: Clear photo of front wheel, tire tread, and front brake caliper

risks.risk: Hidden rust or body damage not shown in close-ups
risks.proof: Full side-profile photos of both sides and underside
risks.if_unproven: priced as cosmetically unverified, assume moderate wear

risks.risk: Electrical system and battery health unknown
risks.proof: Video showing headlight, indicators, horn, and battery voltage check

risks.risk: Accident or repair history not disclosed
risks.proof: Photos of frame alignment, panel gaps, and paint overspray if any
risks.if_unproven: priced as possible undisclosed accident history

proof_requests: Video of engine starting and idling with sound
Clear photo of odometer/gauge cluster showing mileage
Photo of registration/title document matching seller's identity
Close-up photo of frame and engine number
Photos of front wheel, tire, and front brake assembly
Full side-profile photos of both sides of the bike and underside
Video demonstrating gear shifting and brake function while riding
Video showing lights, indicators, and horn functioning
response.reason: The witness clearly identifies a Kawasaki motorcycle, so pricing is possible, but all seller claims about condition, age, and originality are unverifiable from photos alone and must be priced at worst case pending proof.
